Understanding Our Collections

All Perfume Parlour collections offer the same high-quality formulation, concentration, and long-lasting performance.

Whether you choose Bronze or Diamond, the fragrance strength, projection, and overall experience remain consistent.

The difference in categories is based purely on the cost of the fragrance oils used in each scent.

Some fragrances use rarer, more complex, or more expensive ingredients, which naturally places them in higher collections like Platinum or Diamond. This allows you to choose based on the scent you love — not the performance.

Our Story

Perfume Parlour was founded in 2004 by Amir Ismail in Leicester, UK, with a vision to create high-quality fragrance impressions that deliver exceptional performance at an accessible price. At a time when this space was largely unexplored, the brand focused on continuous research, refining quality, enhancing longevity, and perfecting projection.

Over the years, Perfume Parlour has grown into one of the most recognised names in the industry, offering over 2500 fragrances and one of the most diverse fragrance collections in the world. With a strong global customer base and a reputation built on quality and trust, the brand continues to set new standards in fragrance craftsmanship.

In September 2024, Perfume Parlour officially entered Pakistan, bringing the same premium quality and experience to a rapidly growing local audience. In a short time, the brand has built strong customer trust, with a growing presence across major cities and a flagship store in Karachi.

With an expanding range, increasing demand, and a strong returning customer base, Perfume Parlour Pakistan is now focused on reaching every corner of the country through kiosks, retail outlets, and a seamless online experience.

Why Choose Perfume Parlour Pakistan?

At Perfume Parlour Pakistan, we believe luxury shouldn't come with a luxury price tag. Our expertly crafted fragrances are formulated in the UK using premium ingredients, delivering exceptional longevity and projection that rivals designer brands—at a fraction of the cost.
